tex_content.html:
Corollary
Source: topping:page-0047 1. ch3:2.6\group maximum-principle

If a Ricci flow $g(t)$ on a closed manifold is defined for $t\in [0,T]$ and has $R\geq 0$ at $t=0$, then its volume $V(t)$ is weakly decreasing on $[0,T]$.
